description: Join us for an elevated VIP night of fun;  pickleball, expert hormone advice, natural remedies, yoga, meditation, giveaways, drinks & more!
long_description:
Join us for an elevated VIP night of fun; pickleball, expert hormone advice, natural remedies, yoga, meditation, giveaways, drinks & more!

About this Event

YOU BELONG HERE. 💗

Pink Peri/Menopause & Pickleball is not your typical wellness event.
It is a high-energy, feel-good afternoon created for women who are navigating perimenopause, menopause and everything that comes with this powerful stage of life and who are ready for real answers, real connection and a whole lot of fun.
Join us at Ballers Philadelphia for an unforgettable experience where education meets movement, wellness meets play, and women come together to learn, laugh, connect and glow.
Whether you're experiencing symptoms, searching for answers, feeling like yourself has changed, or simply want to connect with women who get it...
This room is for you.

YOUR EXPERIENCE INCLUDES:🧠 REAL MENOPAUSE EDUCATION
Learn from Phyllis Hannah Thompson, Double Certified Menopause Specialist and Founder of Hormone Hacker™, as she shares practical education and natural approaches to navigating the perimenopause journey.
✨ EXPERT SUPPORT YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE

Meet Tiffany Walden, Certified Menopause Specialist, bringing education and support designed to help women better understand and navigate menopause during this stage of life.
🩺 MEDICAL CONVERSATIONS THAT MATTER
Hear from Constance Leach, NP, with education and conversation around topics including HRT, Peptides and PRP a new skin rejuvenation treatment.
💉 THE GLOW-UP STATION
Experience the added wellness and beauty element presented with Cyour Beauty MedSpa, featuring the event's Glow-Up experience and available services including Botox and Vitamin B12 injections. Understand how vitamin injections can support energy and vitality during hormonal change.
🏓 PICKLEBALL FOR ALL LEVELS
Never picked up a paddle? You are still invited.
Come move, laugh and play in a welcoming environment designed for connection and fun, whether you're a beginner, curious to try picklebal
